subject.title: fix(auto-reply): older completed replies stall or vanish when a follow-up message starts a long turn

question: Should OpenClaw release an older completed same-target reply after 20 seconds when the newer turn is still active but has produced no visible reply?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded and preserves visible-winner suppression, but it intentionally changes the user-visible ordering policy between freshness suppression and avoiding prolonged silence.

options.title: Accept bounded chronological fallback
options.body: Permit the older completed reply after 20 seconds of newer-turn silence, then rebase and verify the exact merge head.

options.title: Keep strict newer-turn freshness
options.body: Continue withholding the older reply until the newer turn ends or visibly wins, accepting the existing long-wait behavior.

options.title: Choose a different product policy
options.body: Specify a different timeout or a narrower eligibility rule before implementation proceeds.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded chronological fallback
recommendation.body: Permit the older completed reply after 20 seconds of newer-turn silence, then rebase and verify the exact merge head.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged adjacent foreground-delivery work provides the strongest available ownership signal for the intended freshness contract.
